functions.name: prevent_audit_delete
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_audit_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION
    'Audit log records are immutable and cannot be deleted. (row id: %)',
    OLD.id;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

functions.name: prevent_audit_update
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_audit_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION
    'Audit log records are immutable and cannot be updated. (row id: %)',
    OLD.id;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
